raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Strength for Stage III Endometriosis"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build strength with cycle- and flare-aware modifications"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength - strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5..7 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength - strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4..6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload lower":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload upper":

          bent_over_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds

        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Deload full":
        warmup:
          cycling 6m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 2x4..5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build" (4 weeks):

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - build":

    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower strength - build":

      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper strength - build":

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body - build":

    WEEK 8:

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload upper":

      DAY Friday training 35m "Deload full":

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Peak" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower peak":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper peak":
        warmup:

      DAY Friday training 55m "Full body peak":
